label: 009/L1 CONFIRMED: prepare validates the Running workers line but never probes a pid, so a note saying none while a worker runs is accepted; the receiver seed runs kill -0. The unnamed-worker half is closed as declined by 015 ADR-002. Smallest named-pid change: probe each listed pid and warn on ESRCH; the stated failure needs the declined scan.

009/L2 UNCONFIRMED: the hop seed asks the operator to run /add-dir on Claude, and the wrapper replays only a launch --add-dir, never the note's Added directories line. It fails on an unattended hop when the receiver cannot add the directory itself. Missing evidence: a live Claude run where the model invokes /add-dir. Smallest change: carry the note paths on the record and append --add-dir.

009/L3 CONFIRMED as environment: the history-lookup test writes opencode.db and inherits the ambient OPENCODE_DB, so a host exporting opencode-v1.db makes the full plugin suite red outside relaunch. Smallest change: delete OPENCODE_DB from the child env in that test.
009/L4 REFUTED: the README and the Claude playbook now carry the Running workers, Scheduled and Added directories lines; 017 closed it.

010/L1 CONFIRMED and operator-accepted: isLineageAlive probes the pid and group with signal 0 and never compares start time, so a recycled pid refuses a legitimate re-run with exit 3. Smallest change: record the kernel start time in the spawned row and compare it; the operator chose refusal only.

010/L2 CONFIRMED: a label with no spawned row is never live, and the spawned row is appended from onSpawn after spawn returns. If the parent dies in that window while the lane lives, the next run requeues a live worker and produces two writers. Smallest change: the lane appends its own spawned row with process.pid at boot.

010/L3 CONFIRMED structurally: on Windows the probe is pid-only and lineages are not detached; no Windows run is planned. Smallest change: a Windows StartTime check, or an explicit unsupported statement.

011/L1 REFUTED as written: scratch/live-checks.md records four live lines, AC-001 is Met and the packet goal log is Done, while the implementation summary still says unrecorded and Unmet. Residual: bypass alone was tested only on a bypass-default machine, so the strict replay rule stands. Smallest change: update the summary rows.
011/L2 CONFIRMED as a historical note only: the plan named 158 cli tests and the tree held 162 at build start. No operator-facing failure and no code consequence.

011/L3 REFUTED: the wrapper accepts default in its valid-mode set and replays it as --permission-mode default; the packet goal log records the spelling as Done. The summary sentence saying default is deliberately unmapped is stale. No code change.

012/L1 PARTLY CLOSED: 013 now sets the OpenCode title from SKILLED_LOOP_NAME, but the Pi adapter has no live-name read, so a Pi rename is still lost on a hop. Smallest change: read the Pi live name in the Pi arm and stamp name on the record.

012/L2 CONFIRMED: the title tail search starts at 256 KiB and widens to a 16 MiB cap; a rename older than that is missed and prepare falls back to SKILLED_LOOP_NAME or the generated title. Smallest change: a reverse 1 MiB chunk scan for the two title searches, bounded by file size.
013/L1 is not a limitation: the live bridged title on OpenCode 2.2.7 is recorded as proven after the build. No action.

013/L2 CONFIRMED and accepted: the plugin clears child busy only on session.idle or session.deleted, so a lost child keeps the parent unarmed and the hop falls to auto-compaction. Smallest change: timestamp each child and expire a stale busy flag in hasBusyChild with a log event.
013/L3 CONFIRMED as environment, same root cause as 009/L3: the history-lookup test inherits OPENCODE_DB while its fixture is opencode.db. Smallest change: the one-line child-env fix in that test.
